body:
Hey there! Writing quality content is eating up your time, and AI can genuinely help. Here's what's worth your attention this week.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: teams already using Notion who want AI built into their existing workflow. Free + $10/mo.
[Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Jasper**
Purpose-built AI writing assistant that handles marketing copy, email campaigns, and long-form content with brand voice training. Best for: marketing teams that need consistency at scale. $49/mo.
[Try Jasper Free →](https://jasper.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Writes SEO-optimized content by analyzing top-ranking pages, then grades your drafts in real-time against what Google wants to see. Best for: anyone publishing blogs or articles who actually wants organic traffic. $89/mo.
[Try Surfer SEO Free →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

## Quick Tip

AI writing tools are fastest when you give them guardrails—not a blank page. Instead of "write my blog post," try "write a 1,500-word post on [topic] for [audience], using a conversational tone, with 3 main sections." The specificity cuts editing time in half.

---

**Also worth checking out:** Copy.ai ($36/mo) for quick marketing copy and Writesonic ($19/mo) if you need a lighter-weight alternative to Jasper.

The pattern here? Good writing still requires you to think. These tools speed up the *execution*, not the strategy. Use them to draft faster so you can spend time on what actually moves the needle.

See you next week—keep shipping.
